lockFileMaintenance.description: Periodic `cargo update` to pick up semver-compatible bumps the per-crate rules would miss.

packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major Rust updates. Un-grouped, this is a few hundred separate PRs for a 395-crate tree, which nobody reviews.
Majors stay separate and ungrouped: each one is a breaking change that needs code edits and a green CI run before merging.
GitHub Actions versions move together; one PR is enough.
